items.source:
Expands the NIN (e.g. NOT IN) into a semantically equivalent boolean expressions of ANDs of NEs. Useful for providers that don't provide native NIN support.
For example the 
foo NIN ["bar1", "bar2", "bar3"] (or foo NOT IN ["bar1", "bar2", "bar3"])
express is equivalent to 
foo != "bar1" && foo != "bar2" && foo != "bar3" (e.g. AND(foo NE "bar1" AND( foo NE "bar2" OR(foo NE "bar3"))) )
items.translation:
将 NIN（例如 NOT IN）扩展为语义等价的 NE 的 AND 布尔表达式。对于不支持原生 NIN 支持的提供者非常有用。
例如， 
foo NIN ["bar1", "bar2", "bar3"]（或 foo NOT IN ["bar1", "bar2", "bar3"]）
等价于 
foo != "bar1" && foo != "bar2" && foo != "bar3"（例如 AND(foo NE "bar1" AND( foo NE "bar2" OR(foo NE "bar3")))）

items.source:
Expands the IN into a semantically equivalent boolean expressions of ORs of EQs. Useful for providers that don't provide native IN support. For example the 
foo IN ["bar1", "bar2", "bar3"]
expression is equivalent to 
foo == "bar1" || foo == "bar2" || foo == "bar3" (e.g. OR(foo EQ "bar1" OR(foo EQ "bar2" OR(foo EQ "bar3")))
items.translation:
将 IN 扩展为语义等价的由 EQ 组成的 OR 表达式。 适用于不支持原生 IN 功能的提供者。 例如，
foo IN ["bar1", "bar2", "bar3"]
表达式等价于 
foo == "bar1" || foo == "bar2" || foo == "bar3"（例如 OR(foo EQ "bar1" OR(foo EQ "bar2" OR(foo EQ "bar3")))

items.source:
Transforms the input expression into a semantically equivalent one with negation operators propagated thought the expression tree by following the negation rules: 
        NOT(NOT(a)) = a

        NOT(a AND b) = NOT(a) OR NOT(b)
        NOT(a OR b) = NOT(a) AND NOT(b)

        NOT(a EQ b) = a NE b
        NOT(a NE b) = a EQ b

        NOT(a GT b) = a LTE b
        NOT(a GTE b) = a LT b

        NOT(a LT b) = a GTE b
        NOT(a LTE b) = a GT b

        NOT(a IN [...]) = a NIN [...]
        NOT(a NIN [...]) = a IN [...]
items.translation:
将输入表达式转换为语义等价的表达式，通过将否定算子沿表达式树传播并遵循以下否定规则： 
        NOT(NOT(a)) = a

        NOT(a AND b) = NOT(a) OR NOT(b)
        NOT(a OR b) = NOT(a) AND NOT(b)

        NOT(a EQ b) = a NE b
        NOT(a NE b) = a EQ b

        NOT(a GT b) = a LTE b
        NOT(a GTE b) = a LT b

        NOT(a LT b) = a GTE b
        NOT(a LTE b) = a GT b

        NOT(a IN [...]) = a NIN [...]
        NOT(a NIN [...]) = a IN [...]
